comingLast.roast: a 11-handicapper last in - the honour board is looking the other way
Downes is one good hole of his away from inheriting the lead nobody wants
on 17 at 1.1 a hole - the presentation table is being set
one hot hole and the blue balls change address to Downes's locker
Downes needs him to stay exactly this bad for 5 more holes
1 point buys freedom - Downes is pricing it higher by the minute
his lead over Downes is 3 - a strong gust could move it
3 clear of the worst seat in the house
with 1 to play he is 3 from the drop - points, please, any denomination
